headline.zh: 周末无实质进展：合并仍在探讨，没有宣布、更没有交割
headline.en: No material change over the weekend: still under discussion, not announced, not closed

summary.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 23 日（亚洲/新加坡），Tesla 与 SpaceX（SPCX）仍没有已宣布或已交割的合并，也没有换股比例或正式协议；周末两家公司没有新的官方表态。已确认的仍是：10 月 20 日马斯克确认两家公司成立独立董事特别委员会，条款未定、不保证达成。11 月 12 日彭博援引知情人士称最早 12 月宣布、也可能推迟到 2027 年初，这仍是传闻。新增值得留意的是监管与政治风险：候任众议院情报委员会主席 Jim Himes 11 月 20 日致信马斯克，就乌克兰 Starshield 中断问题威胁不再支持 SpaceX 政府系统拨款。周末马斯克在 X 上只发了与 Terafab 招聘、特斯拉车内置 Starlink 时间表相关的帖子，没有谈合并。
summary.en: As of 23 November 2026 (Asia/Singapore), Tesla and SpaceX (SPCX) still have no announced or closed merger, no exchange ratio and no definitive agreement, and neither company made a new official statement over the weekend. What is confirmed is unchanged: on 20 October Musk confirmed both companies formed special committees of independent directors, with no agreed terms and no guarantee of a deal. Bloomberg's 12 November report, citing people familiar, of an announcement as soon as December or slipping into early 2027 remains a rumor. Newly worth watching is regulatory and political risk: on 20 November incoming House Intelligence chair Jim Himes wrote to Musk threatening to withhold support for funding SpaceX-built government systems over the Ukraine Starshield disruptions. Over the weekend Musk's X posts touched only on Terafab hiring and the timing of embedded Starlink in Tesla cars, not on the merger.

points.zh: 周末（11 月 21–23 日）没有公司公告、监管文件或新的权威媒体独家；新增报道多为评论与分析（如 Motley Fool、Puck 的 William Cohan），不改变事实状态。
points.en: Over the weekend (21–23 November) there was no company announcement, regulatory filing or new scoop from a major outlet; new coverage was mostly commentary and analysis (e.g. Motley Fool, William Cohan at Puck) and does not change the facts.

points.zh: 监管风险加码：Himes 11 月 20 日致信质疑美国政府与 SpaceX 的每一份合同；得州候任总检察长此前也称交易会受「巨大审查」。SpaceX 的国防合同与特斯拉的中国业务仍是两大难点。
points.en: Regulatory risk is building: Himes's 20 November letter questions every US government contract with SpaceX, and Texas's Attorney General-elect earlier said a deal would face 'tremendous scrutiny'. SpaceX's defense contracts and Tesla's China business remain the two big hurdles.

points.zh: 预测市场：CNBC 11 月 16 日报道 Kalshi「2027 年 3 月前合并」概率由 27% 升至 62%。这是押注价格，不是确认。
points.en: Prediction markets: CNBC reported on 16 November that Kalshi's 'merge before March 2027' odds rose to 62% from 27%. That is betting prices, not confirmation.

points.zh: 特斯拉侧需要全部已发行股份至少 50% 同意；马斯克称自己是利益冲突方，不参加委员会讨论，并表示不应因合并本身获得任何奖励。
points.en: On the Tesla side, at least 50% of all shares outstanding must approve; Musk says he is conflicted and not in the committee talks, and that he should not get any award just for doing a merger.

points.zh: 特斯拉 2026 年股东年会定在 12 月 3 日。公开报道称合并目前不在投票议程上。
points.en: Tesla's 2026 annual meeting is on 3 December. Published reports say the merger is not on the ballot.

tsla_analysis.zh:
截至本简报（2026-11-23 上午，亚洲/新加坡），美股周一尚未开盘，最新正式收盘仍是美国 2026-11-20：TSLA 345.82 美元，较前收 374.41 美元下跌 28.59 美元（7.64%）。按 Yahoo Finance 日线，上周五（11 月 13 日）收盘 390.22 美元，整周累计下跌约 11.4%；同期 SPCX 11 月 20 日收于 127.79 美元。多家报道把 11 月 20 日的下跌主要归因于人工智能与成长股普跌，而不是新的合并文件。周末没有新的卖方评级变动可核实；最近的一份仍是汇丰 11 月 20 日把评级上调至 Hold、目标价 359 美元（以 33% 收购溢价对应的 507 美元与独立 DCF 212 美元等权），Dealroom 转述的一致目标价约 417.31 美元。若价格里已含部分被收购溢价，谈判推迟、条款不及预期或监管受阻（例如国会对 SpaceX 国防合同的审查）时，这部分溢价可能回吐。

期权方面没有新的交易日数据：AlphaQuery 截至 2026-11-20 的 20 日隐含波动率均值为 65.48%（认购 65.51%，认沽 65.45%），略低于 69.52% 的历史波动率；成交量认沽/认购比 0.9604，未平仓认沽/认购比 1.0877。周末页面上出现的报价（如约 351 美元、近月平值 IV 约 54%）不是正式收盘数据。没有可独立核对、且与合并一一对应的期权大单明细。以上是公开资料的摘录，不是对价格或波动率的预测。
tsla_analysis.en:
As of this brief (morning of 23 November 2026, Asia/Singapore), US markets have not yet opened for Monday, so the latest official close is still 20 November: TSLA $345.82, down $28.59 (7.64%) from $374.41. On Yahoo Finance daily data, the previous Friday (13 November) close was $390.22, so the stock fell about 11.4% over the week; SPCX closed at $127.79 on 20 November. Several reports attributed the 20 November drop mainly to a broad AI and growth-stock selloff rather than a new merger document. No new sell-side rating change could be verified over the weekend; the latest is still HSBC's 20 November upgrade to Hold with a $359 target (equal weight to a $507 value at a 33% takeover premium and a $212 standalone DCF), and Dealroom cites a consensus target of about $417.31. If the price already embeds part of a takeover premium, that premium could unwind if talks slip, terms disappoint, or regulators push back (for example congressional scrutiny of SpaceX's defense contracts).

There is no new trading-day options data: AlphaQuery's 20-day average implied volatility as of 20 November was 65.48% (calls 65.51%, puts 65.45%), slightly below historical volatility of 69.52%; the volume put/call ratio was 0.9604 and the open-interest put/call ratio 1.0877. Weekend page quotes (such as about $351 and near-dated at-the-money IV of about 54%) are not official closing data. There is no independently verifiable options-flow detail tied specifically to the merger. This summarizes public sources and is not a forecast of price or volatility.
